promoted_source.publisher: Agenția Națională pentru Ocuparea Forței de Muncă (ANOFM)
promoted_source.title: COMPETENT – Newsletter decembrie 2025 / concluziile analizei nevoilor reale de formare profesională

analysis_inputs_reported: training preferences of persons registered with county employment agencies
local economic specificity including traditional and green jobs
observed_facts.digitalisation_finding_reported: Digitalisation and administrative services are described as having an upward trend in counties with urban agglomerations.

promoted_source.source_interpretation: S42 is used only for the conclusions of the reported completed needs analysis. It strengthens current qualitative triangulation that digitalisation/administrative service demand is rising in urban county contexts and that ANOFM used multiple real labour-market inputs. Project objectives, course lists, planned authorisations and participant targets are not treated as need evidence.
limitations: The newsletter is a synthesis rather than the full methodological report and does not publish respondent/sample counts or response rates for the underlying employer input.
No county-level distribution or prevalence for digital/AI skill need is published in the newsletter.
The finding is digitalisation/administrative-services oriented and is not specific to generative AI or the exact AI4WORK instruments.
Coverage is partial within all three target regions because the COMPETENT intervention excludes PTJ counties Dolj and Gorj in Sud-Vest Oltenia, Prahova in Sud-Muntenia and Mureș in Centru.
No qualitative trend statement is converted into a numeric prevalence or H1-H5 point.

forms_and_gdpr_refresh.article13_retention_surface_note: The pre-form Article 13 draft, renderer contract and long-form privacy draft now state the same bounded lifecycle: live respondent records max 180 days after close and hard stop 31.03.2027 absent approved hold; residual provider backup max 92 days from live deletion on a non-renewing validated cycle; erasure replay marker max 24 hours; application/access-log retention max 7 days. These remain draft controls and do not prove the actual provider account configuration.
forms_and_gdpr_refresh.public_surface_observation: Current eucons.ro homepage is commercial; no dedicated AI4WORK research surface was discoverable in fresh site search. No deploy or real collection was inferred.

refresh_conclusion: S42 closes a current-evidence registry gap with an official ANOFM synthesis of a completed 36-county needs analysis while preserving strict claim limits and zero H1-H5 weight. The controlled Drive dashboard was reconciled from stale S01-S40 wording to S01-S42. Article 13 retention transparency was strengthened and mechanically bound to the existing 7-day log, 24-hour replay-marker and 92-day residual-backup ceilings, but live account/provider proof and controller approvals remain external gates. No eligible immutable real adult+employer export exists, so NF06 PROD and downstream synthesis remain fail-closed.
